title: JayTEvidenceGraphV2Schema
description: Decoupled Evidence Graph Schema governing provenance, scope, economic facts, and node non-inference invariants (Directive EZ-E)

SourceIdentityNode.description: Proves the existence and ownership of an official domain/URL via HTTPS.
strictly_forbidden_conclusions: DOES NOT prove local physical store addresses
DOES NOT prove voucher / promotional discounts

SubjectFactNode.description: Proves a specific substantive textual claim extracted verbatim from raw response bytes.
allowed_conclusions: Text claim exists in source document
strictly_forbidden_conclusions: DOES NOT prove merchant discounts unless full economic schema is satisfied

LocalScopeNode.description: Proves geographic applicability (city, district, campus, coordinates).
LocalScopeNode.invariant: CANNOT be inferred from a national/global web root.

EconomicFactNode.description: 12-field economic schema proving actual out-of-pocket savings and voucher validity.
EconomicFactNode.invariant: Missing even 1 field results in tier T1 = 0.

AssetRightNode.description: Proves copyright/license authorization for visual assets.

T4_RADAR.public_claim_allowed: Canonical link and neutral official title only

T3_PUBLIC_FACILITY.public_claim_allowed: Facility information with proven local scope

T2_OFFICIAL_PROGRAM.public_claim_allowed: Official program documentation with proven subject scope

T1_VERIFIED_ECONOMIC_VOUCHER.public_claim_allowed: Verified savings calculation (Currently locked at count = 0)

invariants: SubjectFactNode CANNOT prove EconomicFactNode without 12 mandatory fields
Report SHA-256 MUST strictly match Raw Binary SHA-256 on disk (Zero Mismatch)
